name.en: Myanmar Language — Start with a Greeting
name.my: မြန်မာဘာသာ

teaser.zh: 一句「မင်္ဂလာပါ」，是向陌生世界打開的一扇門。
teaser.en: A simple “မင်္ဂလာပါ” can be the beginning of a new connection.
teaser.my: မင်္ဂလာပါ။ မြန်မာဘာသာစကားကို အတူတူ လေ့လာကြစို့။

story.zh: 初次見面時，一句緬甸語問候往往就能讓對話更親近。字母圓潤、聲調富有節奏，但語言並不只是一套字形：每句話都會受到情境、禮貌與說話對象的影響。
story.en: At a first meeting, even a small greeting can change the mood. Myanmar script has its distinctive rounded forms, but language is more than shapes: politeness, context and the person you speak to all matter.

context.zh: 緬甸語（Burmese / Myanmar language）是緬甸廣泛使用的語言之一，使用緬甸文字書寫。緬甸境內另有多種民族語言；本頁介紹的問候詞不代表所有語言或地方口音。
context.en: Burmese, also called the Myanmar language, is widely used and written in Myanmar script. Many other languages are spoken across the country. The expressions here are an introduction, not a representation of every community or accent.

moments.zh: မင်္ဂလာပါ — 常見正式或禮貌的問候。
moments.en: မင်္ဂလာပါ — a familiar formal or polite greeting.

moments.zh: ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ် — 表達感謝。
moments.en: ကျေးဇူးတင်ပါတယ် — an expression of thanks.

moments.zh: နေလို့ကောင်းလား / နေကောင်းလား — 視語境問候對方近況。
moments.en: နေကောင်းလား — a way to ask whether someone is well.

note.zh: 每個字詞的背後，都是一種與他人建立關係的方法。
note.en: Each phrase is a small invitation to connect.
